description: This file defines error types, error variables, and utility functions for error handling within the Mattermost Focalboard server model, including custom error types, error creation functions, and error type checking functions.

classes.name: ErrNotFound
classes.description: Error type indicating a resource was not found.

classes.name: ErrBadRequest
classes.description: Error type indicating a bad request.

classes.name: ErrForbidden

classes.name: ErrNotImplemented
classes.description: Error type indicating a feature is not implemented.
